constraints: input array 'a' and output Array must have same dtype

axis.description: integer or sequence of integers specifying axes to remove. If any specified axis does not have a length of 1, an error is raised. If not specified, squeeze all length-1 axes in ``a``.
constraints: must be int or Sequence[int] if provided
'axis' values must be in range [0, rank(input)) if provided as int

output.description: copy of ``a`` with length-1 axes removed.
